ns2:course.label: Exploring the Greek and Roman World
ns2:course.description: Focused study of topics in ancient Greek and Roman literature, art, archaeology, and culture in their Mediterranean context. May also explore reflections in later literature and art. Same as CWL 220. May be repeated in separate terms, if topics vary.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as CWL 220. May be repeated in separate terms, if topics vary.
